Wanted is a crazy 2008 action movie about wizards... with guns. It came out of nowhere to be a big hit, in big part thanks to how it uses its concept: curving bullets. So today, let's dive into that topic like we've done before with movies like Live Die Repeat, Bullet Train and The Old Guard to see how it became one of the most memorable action movies of the 2000s.
